title: Android mediaProcessing 后台预算必须进入任务预检与超时恢复
summary: 项目策略要求把 Android 15+ mediaProcessing foreground-service 的有限后台预算视为正式资源约束：启动前对超长任务给出风险，onTimeout 进入明确终止路径，并保证 staging/job state 可恢复或清理。
proposed_rules: Formal media processing starts only from explicit foreground user action.
Success/failure/cancel/timeout all stop the service and settle job state.
Long estimated jobs surface background-budget risk before start.
Timeout/process death preserves recoverable or explicitly cleanable staging state.
note: This harvest records the project's documented policy. The platform-limit statement was not independently re-verified during this pass, and repository search did not locate an implementation of onTimeout; keep Candidate.
